# The scope classifier admits e2e tiers for paths they cannot reach

## Context

neo PR #20321 changed `learn/blog/persistent-memory-for-ai-coding-agents.md` and `apps/portal/resources/data/blog.json`. It ran the engine e2e tier (4 shards) and the Brain-gated tier (10 shards) in full, and its Brain shards queued 7–20 minutes on the organization's 20-job cap. The operator, 2026-11-05: "you changed a markdown blog post file, and that triggered ALL unit and E2E pipelines to run. this is horribly wasteful." Baseline and method: #20328.

## The Problem

`classify-test-scope.yml` admits a tier whenever a changed path falls inside its boundary. Four admissions reach nothing the tier runs. Counts are over the 346 PRs merged into `dev` from 2026-10-13 to 2026-11-05:

| Admitted by | Why the tier cannot reach it | PRs |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/portal/resources/data/**`, through `apps/` | No e2e spec, fixture or config reads portal data; unit's content guards own it | 6 (every blog post) |
| `buildScripts/{create,docs,helpers,release}/**`, through `buildScripts/` | Outside the e2e launch chain (below) | 8 |
| A `neo-agent-skills`-only bump (`package.json` + `package-lock.json`) | Agent instructions, which webpack and Playwright never load. Unit's `prepare.spec.mjs` and `baseline / Skills materialized` cover its install path | 12 |
| Any change outside the E2E boundary, docs included | The Brain tier still runs a one-shard smoke. It tests the Brain's `dev` tip, not the change, and the `dev` push runs the full tier anyway | 67 today, 93 after the rows above |

## The Architectural Reality

- `isE2eRelevantPath` admits all of `apps/` and `buildScripts/` on purpose. The comment on that predicate in `classify-test-scope.yml` reads: "this gate's failure mode is SILENCE. A false positive costs one ~3-minute job". Since #19705, a false positive costs 14 jobs.
- The e2e launch chain draws `buildScripts/` code from:
  - `webpack.server.config.mjs` (`server-start`);
  - the `bundle-*` and `build-highlightjs` builds;
  - `e2eCiSelection.mjs`;
  - the Playwright config, fixtures and specs.
  Their static imports stay inside `build/`, `webpack/` and `util/`.
- `packageJsonRelevance()` already reads `package.json` at both refs. `package-lock.json` admits components and e2e unconditionally.
  - A skills bump changes three entries in the lock: the root specifier, plus `version`, `resolved` and `integrity` on `node_modules/neo-agent-skills`.
- `test-e2e-brain.yml` builds its matrix from `e2e_brain_tier`: one shard for `smoke`, ten for `full`. `WhiteboxE2E.md:44-46` says the tier "never skips", and "Any other pull request runs the smoke subset".
- The `dev` ruleset requires `unit`, `components (1/3)` to `(3/3)`, `e2e-engine`, `build-all` and the baselines. It requires no `e2e-brain` context.

Design authority: the classifier comment quoted above prices a false positive at one ~3-minute job, which no longer holds. The Brain tier's "never skips" is my own AC on #19657, under #19655 (steward @neo-opus-ada). This change keeps that ticket's "always reports".

## The Fix

In `classify-test-scope.yml`:
1. `isE2eRelevantPath` drops `apps/portal/resources/data/`.
2. It drops `buildScripts/{create,docs,helpers,release}/`. Because this is a deny-list, a new `buildScripts/` directory still admits the tier.
3. Packages that never reach a browser tier (`neo-agent-skills`) leave the dependency-kind comparison. `package-lock.json` gets the same both-refs read: once those packages' entries are removed, an unchanged lock admits nothing. An unreadable ref fails toward running.
4. `e2e_brain_tier` gains `none` for a pull request outside the boundary. `test-e2e-brain.yml` then runs one shard whose only step reports the skip and its reason, so the context still reports. A push stays `full`.

Each change gets a red-first arm in `WorkflowScopeClassifier.spec.mjs`. `WhiteboxE2E.md` names the `none` tier.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] #20321's file set (a `learn/blog/*.md` + `blog.json`) yields `run_e2e=false`, `run_components=false`, `e2e_brain_tier=none` and `run_unit=true`.
- [ ] A file under `buildScripts/create|docs|helpers|release/` alone runs no e2e. A file under `buildScripts/build|webpack|util/`, or under a new `buildScripts/` directory, runs both tiers in full.
- [ ] A bump of `neo-agent-skills` alone runs neither components nor e2e. The same bump plus any other lock change runs both, and so does an unreadable `package-lock.json`.
- [ ] A docs-only PR's Brain job reports `none` with its reason and runs no Playwright. A push still selects `full`.
- [ ] The 346-PR corpus, re-run against the changed script, admits the full tiers for fewer than 279 PRs, and every flip falls in one of the four rows above. The PR records this.
- [ ] `WhiteboxE2E.md` states when the tier selects `none`.
- [ ] The Brain job's skip step prints each changed file followed by `in`, or by the rule that left it out, passing the report through `env`. This was @neo-opus-ada's condition for `none`: a misclassification then shows on the PR that carries it.

## Out of Scope

- Spec-level selection inside the boundary (the breadth leaf of #20328).
- Scoping unit, unit-tz, CodeQL or `build-all`.

## Avoided Traps

- **Dropping all of `apps/`:** the engine specs navigate more than 20 apps.
- **An allow-list of `buildScripts/` files:** such lists rot, as the classifier comment records.
- **Removing the Brain job on a skip:** a reported skip costs one short job, while proving that no consumer reads the context costs more.

**Contract Ledger: `classify-test-scope.yml` outputs** (as shipped by PR #20332 at `ec4d932784`, review RA-2)

The callers are `test.yml` (`changes`), `test-e2e.yml` (`changes`) and `test-e2e-brain.yml` (`changes`). Every output reaches them through `on.workflow_call.outputs`.

| Output | Values | Pull request | `dev` push | Unavailable diff | Superseded attempt (stale head) | Consumer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `run_unit` | `'true'` / `'false'` | `'true'` when any path is not docs, or is unit-guarded content (`learn/`, release notes, portal data) | Same rule, applied to the push diff | `'true'` | `'false'` | `test.yml` `unit` + `unit-tz` rows |
| `run_components` | `'true'` / `'false'` | The components rule: `src/`, theme SCSS, component specs/config, a dependency-kind `package.json` change, a lock change beyond browser-unreachable packages, `test.yml`, this workflow | Same rule, applied to the push diff | `'true'` | `'false'` | `test.yml` `components (n/3)` |
| `run_e2e` | `'true'` / `'false'` | The E2E boundary, minus `apps/portal/resources/data/blog.json` and `buildScripts/{create,helpers,release}/` | Same rule, applied to the push diff | `'true'` | `'false'` | `test-e2e.yml` shards + aggregate |
| `e2e_brain_tier` | `'full'` / `'none'` | `'full'` when the E2E boundary or `test-e2e-brain.yml` changes, otherwise `'none'` | **always `'full'`** | `'full'` | `'none'` | `test-e2e-brain.yml` matrix, step gates and receipt |
| `skip_reason` | string | A fixed sentence (a path outside the suite's rules) | Same | `'changed files unavailable'` | The stale-head reason | The skip steps |
| `e2e_boundary_report` | `<file>: in` or `<file>: out (<rule>)`, one line per file | One line per changed file | One line per file in the push diff | not set (empty) | not set (empty) | `test-e2e-brain.yml` skip step, through `env` |

**What a `dev` push runs.** Only the Brain-gated tier is forced to `full`. Unit, components and the engine e2e tier follow the push's own diff, and for a merge that diff is the merged PR's. For PR-side selection (#20330), the push is therefore the safety net in this form: the Brain tier always runs in full, and the engine tier runs in full whenever the push diff reaches the boundary.
